title: Higher Relapse Rate and Resource Utilization With Ara-C Consolidation Chemotherapy Alone Compared to Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation in First Remission in a Cohort of Younger Adults With Acute Myeloid Leukemia With t(8;21) (q22;q22.1).
snippet: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) with t(8;21) is generally classified as favorable-risk AML, with high-dose cytarabine consolidation considered standard post-remission therapy (PRT).
